deal_value.notes: All-cash $192M purchase price funded with available company resources; announced August 26, 2021

calculable.caveats: Informative Research was private and neither the Stewart press release nor deal coverage disclosed its revenue, ARR, or EBITDA; Stewart's SEC filings do not break out IR standalone financials at announcement
